evidence.excerpt: Hyperbolic vision-language models (VLMs) represent image and text features in a geometry naturally suited to hierarchy, but their adaptation to downstream tasks has largely relied on fixed prompts.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Six hierarchical metrics and embedding analyses show that the method produces more taxonomically consistent predictions and induces a hierarchy-consistent organization of parent, class, and image embeddings in hyperbolic space.
